extracted.name: Chocolate waffles party
extracted.description: #GoldenApron23 Week10 challenge ingredient: cinnamon Q: How to make a waffle party with lower calories? A: Get a mini waffle maker 🤓😎 But I have to say you might spend more time than using a normal waffle maker 😂
instruction_lines: Prepare all the ingredients, mix them well and preheat the waffle maker
Since I use the mini waffle maker, I just need to put a quarter cup of the waffle mix into the waffle maker at once
Wait around 1-2 minutes then check, I like to flip it and then wait for 1-2 more minutes.
You can get a mini waffle 🥳 And then you still have to make the rest 🥲 So I will say this waffle party can only happen in weekends 🤣🤣🤣
